description.value: Tea Origin (茗外) is a specialty Chinese tea bar and retail shop in Richmond that presents high-end Chinese teas through a modern lens while honoring traditional brewing methods. Operating under the legal entity Nutrinature Tea & Herbs Ltd., the business sources teas directly from producers in China and has each batch independently tested by Intertek for pesticide residues and heavy metals. Cyclists can stop in for a dine-in tea experience or pick up loose-leaf teas, curated gift sets, and tea accessories to go.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack at 6m; stands at 10m; rack at 27m; rack at 52m; rack at 61m; rack (covered) at 78m; rack at 93m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms the business is open, operating at the OSM address (6833 Buswell St #135, Richmond, BC V6Y 0L3), with matching phone number. The FAQ explicitly states teas, gift sets, and accessories can be purchased to take home, confirming takeout retail. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible tea café and retail shop in Richmond with an active website and confirmed contact details. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking refreshments or specialty tea products.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website lists a catering service and commercial packaging customization program, indicating an established multi-channel operation. The OSM addr:unit tag (135) matches the unit number on the website.
